questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
No — for **chantier Moreau**, Zava Matériaux invoice **FA-2026-0217** should **not** be paid as it stands: it bills **10 palettes** of ZM-20450 blocks, but the delivery note’s handwritten/OCR-read reserves record only **8 palettes received** and **2 missing palettes**.[1][2]

| Line | Billed | Received / tracked | Difference | Amount at stake HT |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ZM-20450 — blocs béton creux | 10 palettes at 79,20 € HT = 792,00 € HT [1] | Delivery note: “received 8 pal.” and “2 missing pallets” (OCR) [2] | 2 palettes overbilled | 2 × 79,20 € = **158,40 € HT** [1][2] |
| ZM-31020 — mortier | 30 sacs at 7,90 € HT = 237,00 € HT [1] | Delivery note shows 30 sacs [2] | none found | 0,00 € HT [1][2] |
| ZM-44108 — acier HA 10 | 24 barres at 9,45 € HT = 226,80 € HT [1] | Delivery note shows 24 barres [2] | none found | 0,00 € HT [1][2] |
| ZM-27340 — linteau | 1 unit at 164,00 € HT = 164,00 € HT [1] | Delivery note shows 1 unit [2] | none found | 0,00 € HT [1][2] |
| Delivery charge | 1 forfait at 65,00 € HT = 65,00 € HT [1] | Delivery was by camion-grue [2] | none found | 0,00 € HT [1][2] |

The invoice total is **1 484,80 € HT**, VAT is **20 % / 296,96 €**, and total is **1 781,76 € TTC**.[1]  
The disputed amount is **158,40 € HT**, VAT impact is **158,40 € × 20 % = 31,68 €**, and disputed TTC is **190,08 € TTC**.[1][2]  
Purchase tracking records order **BC-2026-012** with **1 484,80 € HT ordered**, **1 484,80 € HT invoiced**, and status “Livré le 13/03/2026, facture FA-2026-0217,” but that tracking does not clear the delivery-note reserve on the 2 missing pallets.[3][2]  
A site-meeting action also says invoice **FA-2026-0217** must be checked against the delivery note before payment.[4]  

Before payment, Lamna Bâtiment should settle the **2 missing palettes** with Zava Matériaux, by obtaining a credit note for **158,40 € HT / 190,08 € TTC** or proof of a subsequent delivery covering the missing pallets.[1][2]  
Because the decisive delivery reserve comes from **OCR** on a scanned note, the scan should be visually confirmed if there is any doubt about the handwritten annotation.[2]

questions.question: Use the prepare-site-meeting skill to prepare site meeting no. 4 of the Moreau chantier on 7 April 2026.

answer.text:
Meeting brief for **Chantier Moreau — site meeting no. 4 on 07/04/2026 at 08:30 on site**; the brief is **as of the site meeting no. 3 minutes dated 24/03/2026**, and the latest schedule I found is **PLN-2026-003 indice A dated 17/03/2026**, while the minutes required an indice B update by 27/03/2026 that I did not find in the wiki sources checked.[1][2][9]

## 1) Priority progress points to review

| Priority for meeting no. 4 | Status to check on 07/04/2026 |
|---|---|
| **Wall elevation** was scheduled 16/03–27/03 at 20% in PLN indice A, and the later meeting minutes record it at 70%, so it is the main past-due incomplete item to verify.[2][3] |
| **Framework, roofing and roof window** were scheduled 30/03–03/04 at 0%, and meeting no. 3 says the works were due to start from 30/03 with the roof window from avenant no. 1 installed with the roof covering.[2][11] |
| **External joinery delivery and installation** were no longer aligned with PLN indice A: the schedule had delivery on 30/03 and installation 31/03–02/04, but meeting no. 3 records VanArsdel postponing delivery to 20/04 and installation to 21/04–23/04.[2][4] |
| **Electricity first fix** is scheduled 07/04–10/04 at 0%, and meeting no. 3 also says routing of the extension conduits is planned from 07/04 to 10/04.[2][12] |
| **Opening in the existing wall** remains shown in PLN indice A for 07/04–09/04 at 0%, but meeting no. 3 postponed it to 27/04–29/04 after the joinery installation.[2][7] |
| **Kitchen removal and plumbing** were originally scheduled 27/04–30/04 at 0%, but meeting no. 3 brought them forward to 07/04–10/04 with the clients’ agreement.[2][6] |
| The planned final reception date remains 15/05/2026 according to meeting no. 3.[8] |

## 2) Deliveries and procurement to follow

| Item | Current issue |
|---|---|
| **VanArsdel Menuiseries / BC-2026-009**: purchase tracking still says delivery planned on 30/03/2026, but the later meeting minutes say the delivery is postponed to 20/04/2026 and installation to 21/04–23/04, so this is the key delivery delay to confirm and replan.[10][4] |
| **Zava Matériaux / BC-2026-013**: timber, tiles and zinc were recorded in purchase tracking as due for delivery on 27/03/2026, with no later confirmation found in the cited records.[10] |
| **Zava Matériaux / BC-2026-016**: the roof window and flashing for avenant no. 1 were recorded in purchase tracking as due for delivery on 27/03/2026, and the corresponding roof work was due to start from 30/03.[10][11] |
| **Zava Matériaux / BC-2026-012**: blocks, mortar, steel and lintel were recorded as delivered on 13/03/2026 and invoiced as FA-2026-0217, but the minutes assigned a check of that invoice against the delivery note before payment.[10][9] |

## 3) Open actions from meeting no. 3

| Action | Owner | Due date / status for meeting no. 4 |
|---|---|---|
| Update planning PLN-2026-003 to **indice B**. | Inès Roux | Due 27/03/2026; this is a gap for the meeting because I found the action but not the updated indice B in the sources checked.[9] |
| Check Zava Matériaux invoice FA-2026-0217 against the delivery note of 13/03/2026 before payment. | Bertrand Sauzède | Due 31/03/2026; ask whether the payment check is closed.[9] |
| Confirm the electrical intervention of 07/04/2026. | Damien Pradère | Due 31/03/2026; confirm on 07/04 that Adatum is mobilised for the 07/04–10/04 sequence.[9][12] |
| Empty the kitchen furniture. | Famille Moreau | Due 03/04/2026; this is needed because kitchen removal and plumbing were brought forward to 07/04–10/04.[9][6] |

## 4) Decisions from meeting no. 3 to carry into meeting no. 4

- Temporary closing of openings with wooden panels was decided for 07/04/2026 so insulation can start from 13/04/2026.[5]  
- Kitchen renovation was brought forward to 07/04–10/04 with the clients’ agreement.[6]  
- The existing-wall opening was postponed to 27/04–29/04 after joinery installation.[7]  
- The final reception date was maintained at 15/05/2026.[8]  

## 5) Changes and gaps to decide

- **Planning gap:** meeting no. 3 required PLN-2026-003 indice B by 27/03/2026, but the schedule evidence available here is still indice A dated 17/03/2026, so meeting no. 4 should ask for the issued indice B or approve a revised sequence on site.[9][2]

- **Avenant no. 1 appears scheduled:** the roof-window work from avenant no. 1 is included in the schedule line “Charpente, couverture et fenêtre de toit” and in purchase order BC-2026-016, so I did not identify an amendment whose work is wholly unscheduled in the cited evidence.[2][10]

answer.text:
Au vu des factures Zava citées, au 16/03/2026, Zava Matériaux ne facture pas toujours aux prix du contrat-cadre 2026 : les chantiers Moreau et Les Nacrines ont chacun une ligne au-dessus du tarif contractuel, pour un écart total HT de +24,00 € sur Moreau et +110,00 € sur Les Nacrines.[1][2][3][4]

Le contrat-cadre indique que les prix applicables sont les prix nets HT du tarif 2026 annexé, fermes pendant la durée du contrat, et applicables à chaque commande quel que soit le chantier de livraison.[1]
